integrity: The exact six-dimensional mRNA/protein repressilator equations were checked in complete mathematical treatments. The complete 2006 generalized-model article, complete Buzzi–Llibre preprint, complete 2018 Hopf analysis, and complete open 2018 generalized-repressilator manuscript were compared at statement and implication level. Previously published Hopf, stability, limit-cycle, and heteroclinic results are not claimed as new. The conditional laws, variance identities, equality rigidity, and maximum-slope obstruction were independently reconstructed, and the critical algebra was replayed with the packaged checker.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns compactly supported invariant probability measures in the nonnegative concentration orthant.
The maximum-slope condition is a sufficient obstruction to non-equilibrium compact stationary states, not a claimed sharp Hopf or global-stability threshold.
The deterministic variance identities do not model intrinsic molecular noise.
The original 2000 publisher record anchors provenance and date; exact equations and mathematical comparisons were checked in later full-system treatments.
A differently phrased fluctuation identity could remain in unindexed literature.
title: Exact stationary variance cascade and a global slope obstruction in the repressilator
